Key bindings

Click a key to change it. Press Esc to cancel.

Ctrl+W closes the browser tab in most browsers. The game asks before leaving mid-match, but C is the safer crouch key.

Killstreaks

Chain kills without dying to earn rewards.

    Career

    Progress saves in this browser only. The online page and a downloaded copy keep separate saves, so use Export and Import to move your rank, stats and settings between them.

    Controls

    W A S DMove
    MouseLook
    Left clickFire · knife slash
    Right clickAim down sights · knife stab
    ShiftSprint
    C CtrlCrouch
    SpaceJump (vault crates and sandbags)
    RReload
    1 2 3 4Weapon slots. Classic: primary · sidearm · knife. Two-Gun: gun · gun · knife. Overkill: three guns, knife on 4
    Wheel QCycle weapons · last weapon
    GFrag grenade, hold to cook
    FDeploy killstreak
    TabScoreboard
    BWeapon menu (Sandbox)
    EPick up a dropped weapon
    EscPause

    These are the defaults. Change any key in Settings. Arrow keys also turn the camera.

    Killstreaks: 3 kills earns a Recon UAV, 5 a mortar strike, 7 a sentry gun. Knife an enemy from behind for an instant kill.

    Weapon menu

    Sandbox only. Pick anything; it stays with you when you respawn. Press B or Esc to close.

    Multiplayer

    Two players, peer to peer: co-op Survival or Zombies, or Free for All and Team Deathmatch against each other (bots fill the rest). No account. The host’s computer runs the match.

      Joiner: 1) paste the host’s invite · 2) make a reply · 3) send it back

      Paused

      The browser didn’t let the game capture your mouse. Click Resume to try again, or play without mouse lock and the camera will follow your cursor while it’s over the game.
